triage.kind_span: Tekla World Healthcare Fund (the "Trust") is issuing non-transferable rights ("Rights") to its Shareholders of record as of the close of business on March 8, 2021 (the "Record Date").

subject_names.span: Tekla World Healthcare Fund (the "Trust") is issuing non-transferable rights ("Rights")

subject_tickers.span: New York Stock Exchange Symbol: THW

security_class.span: These Rights will allow you to subscribe for one (1) common share of beneficial interest ("Share") of the Trust for every three (3) Rights held (the "Offer").

rights_per_share.span: You will receive one Right for each whole Share that you hold of record as of the Record Date

rights_per_new_share.span: The Rights entitle a Shareholder to acquire, at the Subscription Price, one Share for every three Rights held.

price_reference.span: The subscription price per Share (the "Subscription Price") will be determined based upon a formula equal to 95% of the volume weighted average price of a Share on the NYSE on the date on which the Offer expires

price_pct.span: The subscription price per Share (the "Subscription Price") will be determined based upon a formula equal to 95% of the volume weighted average price of a Share on the NYSE on the date on which the Offer expires

price_floor_pct_nav.span: If, however, the Formula Price is less than 90% of the net asset value ("NAV") per Share at the close of trading on the NYSE on the Expiration Date (as defined below), then the Subscription Price will be 90% of the Trust's NAV per Share

record_date.span: to its Shareholders of record as of the close of business on March 8, 2021 (the "Record Date")

expiration_date.span: which starts on March 16, 2021 and ends at 5:00 p.m., Eastern Time, on April 6, 2021 (the "Expiration Date").

transferable.span: The Rights are non-transferable, which means that the Rights may not be purchased or sold, and a Shareholder cannot trade the Rights on the secondary market

over_subscription.span: such Shares which have not been subscribed for will be offered, by means of the Over-Subscription Privilege, to Shareholders who have exercised all the Rights initially issued to them

max_new_shares.span: The Trust is issuing to its Shareholders non-transferable Rights to subscribe for an aggregate of 10,077,635 Shares. The Trust may increase the number of Shares subject to subscription by up to 25% of the Shares, for an aggregate total of 12,597,044 Shares.

notes: Final prospectus (424B1) dated March 4, 2021. Subscription price = 95% of the VWAP on the NYSE on the expiration date and the four preceding trading days (the Formula Price), floored at 90% of NAV per Share at the close on the Expiration Date; estimated subscription price $17.00 as of February 26, 2021. max_new_shares is the base 10,077,635; the Trust may increase the offer by up to 25% (up to an additional 2,519,409 Shares, 12,597,044 total) to honour over-subscription requests, excluded per the schema. Rights are not listed. Subscription period March 16, 2021 to April 6, 2021, unless extended; only one expiration date is stated.
